study: fitness equipment market in the united states

charts.title: Revenue of the sports equipment market worldwide from 2018 to 2028 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Revenue of the sports equipment industry worldwide 2018-2028
charts.description: The global revenue in the 'Sports Equipment' segment of the toys & hobby market was forecast to continuously increase between 2024 and 2028 by in total 44 billion U.S. dollars (+25.65 percent). After the eighth consecutive increasing year, the indicator is estimated to reach 215.54 billion U.S. dollars and therefore a new peak in 2028.

charts.title: Revenue of the sports equipment market worldwide by country in 2023 (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Revenue of the sports equipment market worldwide by country 2023
charts.description: From the selected regions, the ranking by revenue in the 'Sports Equipment' segment of the toys & hobby market is lead by China with 37.3 billion U.S. dollars and is followed by the United States (18.5 billion U.S. dollars). In contrast, the ranking is trailed by Argentina with 972.68 million U.S. dollars, recording a difference of 36.3 billion U.S. dollars to China.
charts.source: Statista Consumer Market Insights Revenue in million U.S. dollars

charts.title: Revenue in the Sports Equipment market for different segments Worldwide from 2018 to 2028 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Revenue in the Sports Equipment market Worldwide 2018-2028
charts.description: Over the last two observations, the revenue is forecast to significantly increase in all segments. As part of the positive trend, the indicator achieves the maximum value across all eight different segments by the end of the comparison period. Notably, the segment Exercise Equipment stands out with the highest value of 59.47 billion U.S. dollars.

charts.title: Revenue of the exercise equipment market worldwide 2018 to 2023, with a forecast until 2028 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Revenue of the exercise equipment market worldwide 2018-2028
charts.description: The total revenue of the global exercise equipment market was forecast to continuously increase between 2024 and 2028 by in total 12.8 billion U.S. dollars (or just over 27 percent). Products within this segment include a variety of items and machines for physical activity and fitness, from treadmills to fitness balls.

charts.title: Revenue of the sports equipment industry in the United States from 2018 to 2024, with a forecast to 2028 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Revenue of the sports equipment industry in the U.S. 2018-2028
charts.description: The revenue in the 'Sports Equipment' segment of the toys & hobby market in the United States was forecast to continuously increase between 2024 and 2028 by in total 3.5 billion U.S. dollars (+17.98 percent). After the eighth consecutive increasing year, the indicator is estimated to reach 22.99 billion U.S. dollars and therefore a new peak in 2028.

charts.title: Sports equipment market revenue in the United States from 2018 to 2028, by product type (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Sports equipment market revenue in the U.S. from 2018 to 2028, by product type
charts.description: Over the last two observations, the revenue is forecast to significantly increase in all segments. Considering the nine different types presented in this statistics, 'Sports Equipment' leads the ranking with 22.99 billion U.S. dollars revenue. Contrastingly, 'Racket Sports Equipment' is ranked last, with 0.54 billion U.S. dollars. Their difference, compared to the Sports Equipment, lies at 22.45 billion U.S. dollars.

charts.title: Revenue of the exercise equipment market in the United States 2018 to 2023, with a forecast until 2028 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Revenue of the exercise equipment market in the United States 2018-2028
charts.description: The exercise equipment market in the United States, which includes items such as treadmills, elliptical machines, free weights, and many other fitness goods, generated a total revenue of about five and a half billion U.S. dollars in 2023. Between 2024 and 2028, this specific market's revenue was expected to grow by about 20 percent.

charts.title: Sporting goods store sales in the United States from 1992 to 2022 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Sporting goods store sales in the U.S. from 1992 to 2022
charts.description: In 2022, sporting goods store sales in the United States amounted to about 63.4 billion U.S. dollars; a considerable jump compared to previous years, but a slight drop compared to 2021.

charts.title: Monthly retail sales of sporting goods stores in the United States from January 2017 to December 2023 (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Sporting goods store monthly sales in the U.S. from 2017 to 2023
charts.description: In December 2023, U.S. sporting goods stores had sales amounting to an estimated 7.1 billion U.S. dollars. This was an increase of nearly 1.8 billion U.S. dollars compared to the previous month. Dick's Sporting Goods and Bass Pro are two of the leading companies in this sector in the United States.

charts.title: Total mail-order and e-commerce sales of sporting goods in the United States from 2003 to 2022 (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Mail-order and e-commerce sales of sporting goods in the U.S. 2003-2022
charts.description: In the United States, the value of sporting goods e-commerce sales was 33.6 billion U.S. dollars in 2022, down from 37 billion U.S. dollars in 2021. In 2022, total mail-order and e-commerce sales of sporting goods added up to 39 billion U.S. dollars.

charts.title: Value of athletics and gymnastics equipment imports and exports in the United States from 2015 to 2022 (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: U.S. athletic and gymnastic equipment import and export trade value from 2015 to 2022
charts.description: In 2023, the value of athletics and gymnastics equipment imported to the United States was approximately 2.37 billion U.S. dollars, which is a significant drop compared to the previous year. U.S. exports had also experienced a decline of approximately 80 million U.S. dollars from 2022 to 2023.

charts.title: Manufacturers (wholesale) sales sports products industry in the U.S. from 2008 to 2023 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Wholesale sales of the U.S. sporting goods industry in the U.S. 2008-2023
charts.description: The statistic depicts the manufacturers' (wholesale) sales of sporting goods equipment, fitness equipment, sports apparel, athletic footwear, and sports licensed merchandise in the U.S. from 2008 to 2023. In 2023, wholesale sales amounted to about 121 billion U.S. dollars, which is a record for the industry.

charts.title: Sports products manufacturers' wholesale sales in the U.S. from 2008 to 2023, by category (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Wholesale sales of the sports products industry by category 2008-2023
charts.description: The statistic shows the wholesale sales of sporting goods equipment, sports apparel, fitness equipment, athletic footwear, and sports licensed merchandise in the United States from 2008 to 2023. In 2023, sales in the athletic footwear category amounted to approximately 21.5 billion U.S. dollars.

charts.title: U.S. consumer fitness equipment wholesale sales from 2007 to 2023 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: U.S. consumer fitness equipment wholesale sales 2007-2023
charts.description: In 2023, manufacturers' wholesale sales of home fitness equipment reached slightly over 6.5 billion U.S. dollars, reflecting an eight percent increase on-year. In contrast, institutional fitness equipment sales in the U.S. amounted to about 1.69 billion U.S. dollars in the same year.

charts.title: Fitness center equipment U.S. wholesale sales from 2007 to 2023 (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Institutional fitness equipment wholesale sales in the U.S. 2007-2023
charts.description: This statistic shows the commercial fitness equipment wholesale sales in the United States for use in fitness centers in the U.S. from 2007 to 2023. In 2023, institutional wholesale sales of fitness equipment reached approximately 1.69 billion U.S. dollars.

charts.title: Wholesale sales of home gyms for consumers in the United States from 2007 to 2023 (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Wholesale sales (consumer segment) of home gyms in the U.S. 2007-2023
charts.description: This statistic shows the wholesale sales of home gyms in the United States from 2007 to 2023. In 2023, wholesale sales of these products reached an estimated 463 million U.S. dollars, falling slightly from the previous year. This figure nevertheless represented a 9.3 percent increase on-year..

charts.title: Wholesale sales of exercise cycles for consumers in the U.S. from 2007 to 2023 (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Wholesale sales (consumer segment) of exercise cycles in the U.S. 2007-2023
charts.description: This statistic shows the wholesale sales of exercise cycles for consumers in the United States from 2007 to 2023. In 2023, wholesale sales of these home use products reached slightly over one billion U.S. dollars, more than double the sales generated in 2019.

charts.title: Wholesale sales of elliptical machines for consumers in the U.S. from 2007 to 2023 (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Wholesale sales (consumer segment) of elliptical machines in the U.S. 2007-2023
charts.description: This statistic shows the wholesale sales of elliptical machines for consumers in the United States from 2007 to 2023. In 2023, sales of these consumer products reached approximately 807 million U.S. dollars.

charts.title: Wholesale sales of free weights for consumers in the U.S. from 2007 to 2023 (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Wholesale sales (consumer segment) of free weights in the U.S. 2007-2023
charts.description: This statistic shows the wholesale sales of home use free weights in the United States from 2007 to 2023. In 2023, wholesale sales of these consumer products reached over 560 million U.S. dollars, a 11.2 percent increase from the previous year.

charts.title: Wholesale sales of abdominal machines for consumers in the U.S. from 2007 to 2023 (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Wholesale sales (consumer segment) of ab machines in the U.S. 2007-2023
charts.description: This statistic shows the wholesale sales of abdominal machines for consumers in the United States from 2007 to 2023. In 2023, wholesale sales of these home use products reached approximately 255 million U.S. dollars.

charts.short: Hibbett Sports' net sales in the U.S. from 2015 to 2024
charts.description: The timeline depicts the net sales of Hibbett Sports, Inc. from financial year of 2015 to 2024. In the fiscal year ended on February 3, 2024, net sales of Hibbett Sports amounted to around 1.73 billion U.S. dollars, which is an increase from last year's figure.

charts.title: Net sales of Hibbett Sports in the United States from fiscal year 2017 to 2024, by product category (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Hibbett Sports' net sales in the U.S. from 2017 to 2024, by product category
charts.description: In the fiscal year ended on February 3, 2024, Hibbett Sports' footwear sales accounted for more than 1.2 billion U.S. dollars of the company's total net sales. charts.title: Net sales of Big 5 Sporting Goods in the United States from 2017 to 2023 (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Big 5 Sporting Goods' net sales in the U.S. from 2017 to 2023
charts.description: In 2023, net sales of Big 5 Sporting Goods stood at approximately 885 million U.S. dollars in the United States, a noticeable decrease from last year's numbers. Sales were at their highest in 2021, when the company generated a net revenue of more than 1.16 billion U.S. dollars.

charts.title: Dollar sales share of Big 5 Sporting Goods in the United States in 2023, by product category (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Big 5 Sporting Goods' dollar sales share in the U.S. in 2023, by product category
charts.description: This statistic depicts the dollar sales share of Big 5 Sporting Goods in the United States, by product category. In the fiscal year of 2023, Big 5 Sporting Goods' hard goods category sales amounted to some 475 million U.S. dollars.

charts.title: Net sales of Nautilus Inc. worldwide from 2020 to 2023 (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Global revenue of Nautilus Inc. from 2020 to 2023
charts.description: In its financial year ended on March 31, 2023, Nautilus Inc., an American fitness goods manufacturer, had global net sales amounting to about some 287 million U.S. dollars, which is a significant decrease compared to the previous year. In the year ended March 31, 2022, the company's global net sales amounted to roughly 590 million U.S. dollars.

Nautilus Inc. generated just under four and a half million U.S. dollars in the EMEA region.

charts.title: Share of Americans interested in health and fitness as of December 2023, by income
charts.short: Share of Americans interested in health and fitness 2023
charts.description: The statistics shows the share of Americans who were interested in health and fitness in 2023. The results were sorted by income tier. As of December 2023, 42 percent of respondents who stated their income was high said they were interested in health and fitness. The survey was conducted in 2023, among 49,514 respondents.

charts.title: Consumers who purchased fitness gear in the past month and plan to purchase in the next three months in the United States in 2023
charts.short: Fitness gear buying behavior and plans among consumers in the United States 2023
charts.description: In spring 2023, approximately 13 percent of consumers in the United States said they had purchased fitness gear in the last month. A slightly higher share of respondents said they planned to buy fitness equipment in the near future.
categories: Plan to purchase in the next three months

charts.title: Leading shopping habits among shoppers who bought fitness gear compared to shoppers who did not in the United States in 2023
charts.short: Shopping habits among fitness gear buyers in the United States 2023
charts.description: In 2023, more than 40 percent of U.S. consumers that purchased fitness equipment said they would switch brands if the brand did not align with their own values. In contrast, just over a third of people who did not buy fitness gear said the same.
categories: Switch brands if they do not align with values

charts.title: Consumers who purchased fitness equipment in the past month in the United States from 2021 to 2023, by season
charts.short: Consumers who bought fitness gear in the United States 2021-2023, by season
charts.description: In the fall of 2023, approximately 14 percent of consumers in the United States said they had purchased fitness gear in the last month, a slight increase compared to previously studied seasons and especially compared to fall 2022.

charts.title: Leading channels used when buying fitness equipment among consumers in the United States in 2023
charts.short: Leading channels used when buying fitness gear in the United States 2023
charts.description: In 2023, approximately half of U.S. consumers who bought fitness equipment goods in the past month specifically purchased them in-store. Online channels were a popular second choice among fitness enthusiasts in the United States.

charts.title: Share of fitness equipment purchasers who would pay more for sustainably sourced items in the United States in 2023
charts.short: Fitness gear buyers who would pay more for sustainable items in the U.S. 2023
charts.description: In 2023, the vast majority (more than 80 percent) of consumers who bought fitness equipment in the last month said they would be willing to pay more for sustainably sourced items.
charts.note: United States; Fall 2023; 215*; 21-65 years; Consumers who bought fitness gear in the past month; * For the entire study, 1,502 consumers were surveyed. Read more

charts.title: Extra amount fitness equipment shoppers would be willing to pay for sustainable items in the United States in 2023
charts.short: Premium fitness gear buyers would pay for sustainable items in the U.S. 2023
charts.description: In 2023, the vast majority of surveyed fitness equipment shoppers in the United States said they would be willing to invest more money in sustainable products. Specifically, about 35 percent of respondents said they would be willing to pay a premium of five to nine percent for sustainably sourced options. Only about five percent was willing to pay an additional 25 percent or more.
